description: Delta-177 is a Dushanbe-based team. I’m a backend developer (C#/.NET, ASP.NET, SQL) learning Python and machine learning. We plan to tackle “Field Shift”: a tool that uses NASA satellite data to help farmers in Tajikistan choose climate-resilient crop rotations. Looking for: Python/data enthusiasts, someone with agriculture or ecology knowledge, a UI/UX designer, and a confident presenter. Team language: Tajik/Russian, English welcome!
